milestones.text: The Center was established under Thai Nguyen University of Agriculture and Forestry.
First provincial- and ministry-level projects on land resources and environment.
Expanded GIS – remote sensing capacity and international cooperation.
Grown into a research, consulting, and technology-transfer unit for mountain resources and environment.
